```{r setup}

pkgs <- c("tidyRSS", "httr2", "dplyr", "purrr", "glue",
          "lubridate", "stringr", "readr", "jsonlite", "htmltools", "tidyr")

invisible(lapply(pkgs, function(p) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(p)
  library(p, character.only = TRUE)
}))

DAYS_BACK   <- 7
SLEEP_SEC   <- 1.5
OUTPUT_DIR  <- "data"
NEWSAPI_KEY <- Sys.getenv("NEWSAPI_KEY")
GROQ_KEY    <- Sys.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY")
GROQ_MODEL  <- "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

ticker_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ticker,  ~nome,            ~query_google,                         ~query_newsapi,
  "ZC=F",   "Corn",           "corn futures commodities market",      "corn futures",
  "ZO=F",   "Oat",            "oat grain futures market price",       "oat futures grain",
  "KE=F",   "HRW Wheat",      "wheat futures Kansas HRW grain",       "wheat futures grain market",
  "ZR=F",   "Rough Rice",     "rice futures commodity market price",  "rice futures commodity",
  "GF=F",   "Feeder Cattle",  "cattle futures livestock market",      "cattle futures livestock",
  "ZS=F",   "Soybeans",       "soybean futures commodities market",   "soybean futures",
  "ZM=F",   "Soybean Meal",   "soybean meal futures market",          "soybean meal futures",
  "ZL=F",   "Soybean Oil",    "soybean oil futures market",           "soybean oil futures"
)

empty_news <- function() {
  tibble(
    ticker    = character(),
    nome      = character(),
    fonte     = character(),
    titulo    = character(),
    link      = character(),
    veiculo   = character(),
    publicado = as.POSIXct(character())
  )
}

```


```{r fetch_functions}

fetch_google_news <- function(ticker, nome, query_google, days_back = DAYS_BACK, ...) {
  url <- glue("https://news.google.com/rss/search?q={URLencode(query_google)}&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en")
  tryCatch({
    feed <- tidyRSS::tidyfeed(url, clean_tags = TRUE)
    if (is.null(feed) || nrow(feed) == 0) return(empty_news())
    result <- feed |>
      mutate(ticker = ticker, nome = nome, fonte = "Google News",
             publicado = as.POSIXct(item_pub_date, tz = "America/Sao_Paulo")) |>
      filter(publicado >= Sys.time() - days(days_back)) |>
      select(ticker, nome, fonte,
             titulo = item_title, link = item_link,
             veiculo = item_feed_title, publicado)
    if (nrow(result) == 0) empty_news() else result
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Google] Error {ticker}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    empty_news()
  })
}

fetch_newsapi <- function(ticker, nome, query_newsapi, days_back = DAYS_BACK, ...) {
  if (is.na(NEWSAPI_KEY) || NEWSAPI_KEY == "") return(empty_news())
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request("https://newsapi.org/v2/everything") |>
      req_url_query(q = query_newsapi,
                    from = format(Sys.Date() - days_back, "%Y-%m-%d"),
                    sortBy = "publishedAt", language = "en",
                    pageSize = 10, apiKey = NEWSAPI_KEY) |>
      req_perform() |> resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)
    arts <- resp$articles
    if (is.null(arts) || length(arts) == 0) return(empty_news())
    arts <- as_tibble(arts)
    if (nrow(arts) == 0) return(empty_news())
    result <- arts |>
      mutate(ticker = ticker, nome = nome, fonte = "NewsAPI",
             publicado = as.POSIXct(publishedAt, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC") |>
               with_tz("America/Sao_Paulo"),
             veiculo = if (is.data.frame(source)) source$name else as.character(source)) |>
      filter(publicado >= Sys.time() - days(days_back)) |>
      select(ticker, nome, fonte, titulo = title, link = url, veiculo, publicado)
    if (nrow(result) == 0) empty_news() else result
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[NewsAPI] Error {ticker}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    empty_news()
  })
}

fetch_all_news <- function(days_back = DAYS_BACK) {
  ticker_map |>
    pmap_dfr(function(ticker, nome, query_google, query_newsapi) {
      message(glue("  Fetching: {nome} ({ticker})"))
      g <- fetch_google_news(ticker, nome, query_google, days_back)
      Sys.sleep(SLEEP_SEC)
      n <- fetch_newsapi(ticker, nome, query_newsapi, days_back)
      combined <- bind_rows(g, n)
      if (nrow(combined) > 0 && any(!is.na(combined$titulo) & combined$titulo != "")) {
        combined <- combined |>
          filter(!is.na(titulo), titulo != "") |>
          distinct(titulo, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
          arrange(desc(publicado))
      }
      combined
    })
}
```

```{r groq_functions}

groq_summarize <- function(headlines_text, commodity_name, model = GROQ_MODEL) {
  if (is.na(GROQ_KEY) || GROQ_KEY == "") return(NULL)
  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are a commodity market analyst. Below are news headlines from the past week ",
    "about ", commodity_name, " futures markets.\n\n",
    "Headlines:\n", headlines_text, "\n\n",
    "Write a concise market summary (3-5 sentences) covering:\n",
    "1. The main price drivers or trends mentioned\n",
    "2. Key supply/demand factors\n",
    "3. Any relevant geopolitical or weather events\n",
    "4. Overall market sentiment (bullish/bearish/neutral)\n\n",
    "Be direct and analytical. Do not repeat headlines verbatim."
  )
  tryCatch({
    resp <- request("https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions") |>
      req_headers("Authorization" = paste("Bearer", GROQ_KEY),
                  "Content-Type"  = "application/json") |>
      req_body_json(list(
        model    = model,
        messages = list(
          list(role = "system", content = "You are a concise commodity market analyst. Always respond in English."),
          list(role = "user",   content = prompt)
        ),
        temperature = 0.3,
        max_tokens  = 300
      )) |>
      req_timeout(30) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_body_json()
    resp$choices[[1]]$message$content
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Groq] Error for {commodity_name}: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    NULL
  })
}

generate_all_summaries <- function(df) {
  if (is.na(GROQ_KEY) || GROQ_KEY == "") {
    return(tibble(ticker = character(), nome = character(), summary = character()))
  }
  df |>
    filter(!is.na(titulo), titulo != "") |>
    group_by(ticker, nome) |>
    summarise(headlines = paste(titulo, collapse = "\n- "), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(summary = map2_chr(headlines, nome, function(h, name) {
      Sys.sleep(0.5)
      result <- groq_summarize(h, name)
      if (is.null(result)) "No news available this week." else result
    })) |>
    select(ticker, nome, summary)
}

summaries_df <- generate_all_summaries(news_df)

# Garante todos os tickers no sumario, mesmo sem noticias
summaries_df <- ticker_map |>
  select(ticker, nome) |>
  left_join(summaries_df, by = c("ticker", "nome")) |>
  mutate(summary = replace_na(summary, "No news found for this commodity this week."))

readr::write_csv(summaries_df, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, glue("summaries_{Sys.Date()}.csv")))

```




```{r groq_portfolio}

# Resumo global do portfolio via Groq

groq_portfolio_summary <- function(summaries_df) {
  if (is.na(GROQ_KEY) || GROQ_KEY == "") return(NULL)

  all_summaries <- summaries_df |>
    mutate(block = glue("{nome} ({ticker}): {summary}")) |>
    pull(block) |>
    paste(collapse = "\n\n")

  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are a senior commodity portfolio analyst. Below are individual weekly summaries ",
    "for each commodity in an agricultural futures portfolio.\n\n",
    all_summaries, "\n\n",
    "Write a comprehensive portfolio-level market brief (5-7 sentences) that:\n",
    "1. Identifies the dominant macro theme across the portfolio this week\n",
    "2. Highlights the top 2-3 commodities with the most significant moves or news\n",
    "3. Notes any cross-commodity correlations or common drivers (weather, USD, energy)\n",
    "4. Gives an overall portfolio sentiment (risk-on / risk-off / mixed)\n",
    "5. Flags any key events or reports to watch next week\n\n",
    "Be direct, analytical, and concise. Write as a professional market brief."
  )

  tryCatch({
    resp <- request("https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions") |>
      req_headers("Authorization" = paste("Bearer", GROQ_KEY),
                  "Content-Type"  = "application/json") |>
      req_body_json(list(
        model    = GROQ_MODEL,
        messages = list(
          list(role = "system", content = "You are a senior commodity portfolio analyst. Always respond in English."),
          list(role = "user",   content = prompt)
        ),
        temperature = 0.3,
        max_tokens  = 500
      )) |>
      req_timeout(40) |>
      req_perform() |>
      resp_body_json()
    resp$choices[[1]]$message$content
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(glue("[Groq] Portfolio summary error: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
    NULL
  })
}

portfolio_summary <- groq_portfolio_summary(summaries_df)

```

```{r portfolio_overview}

# ── Painel de contagem de noticias por ticker ─────────────────────────────────
count_cards <- ticker_counts |>
  pmap(function(ticker, nome, n, ...) {
    bar_width <- if (max(ticker_counts$n) > 0) round((n / max(ticker_counts$n)) * 100) else 0
    bar_color <- if (n == 0) "#e5e7eb" else if (n >= 5) "#2c5f2e" else "#86b48a"
    div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.8rem; margin-bottom:.5rem;",
      tags$span(style = "width:110px; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600; color:#374151;", nome),
      tags$code(style = "font-size:.72rem; color:#6b7280; width:55px;", ticker),
      div(style = glue("height:14px; width:{bar_width}%; min-width:4px; background:{bar_color}; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0;"),
          " "),
      tags$span(style = "font-size:.82rem; color:#6b7280;", paste(n, "articles"))
    )
  })

div(class = "portfolio-panel",
  div(style = "margin-bottom:1rem;",
    tagList(count_cards)
  )
)
```

## Weekly AI Summary

```{r weekly_overview}
sentiment_badge <- function(summary_text) {
  kw_bull <- c("rally","surge","gain","rise","high","strong","bull","upward","demand","support")
  kw_bear <- c("drop","fall","decline","weak","low","bear","downward","surplus","pressure","loss")
  s <- tolower(summary_text)
  b  <- sum(sapply(kw_bull, grepl, x = s))
  br <- sum(sapply(kw_bear, grepl, x = s))
  if (b > br)       tags$span(class = "sentiment bullish", "Bullish")
  else if (br > b)  tags$span(class = "sentiment bearish", "Bearish")
  else              tags$span(class = "sentiment neutral",  "Neutral")
}

cards <- summaries_df |>
  left_join(ticker_counts |> select(ticker, n), by = "ticker") |>
  pmap(function(ticker, nome, summary, n, ...) {
    div(class = "summary-card",
      div(class = "summary-header",
        tags$span(class = "summary-name",   nome),
        tags$code(class = "summary-ticker", ticker),
        sentiment_badge(summary),
        tags$span(class = "summary-count",  paste(n, "articles"))
      ),
      div(class = "summary-body", summary)
    )
  })

tagList(cards)
```

## News by Commodity

```{r render_cards}
make_news_card <- function(titulo, link, veiculo, publicado, fonte, ...) {
  badge_color <- if (fonte == "Google News") "#4285F4" else "#E84393"
  div(class = "news-card",
    div(class = "news-meta",
      tags$span(class = "badge", style = paste0("background:", badge_color), fonte),
      tags$span(class = "veiculo", veiculo),
      tags$span(class = "data", format(publicado, "%m/%d %H:%M"))
    ),
    a(href = link, target = "_blank", class = "news-titulo", titulo)
  )
}

render_ticker_section <- function(ticker_key, df_ticker) {
  nome_display <- unique(df_ticker$nome)[1]
  df_valid     <- df_ticker |> filter(!is.na(titulo), titulo != "")
  n_articles   <- nrow(df_valid)

  cards <- if (n_articles == 0) {
    tags$blockquote(
      style = "color:#9ca3af; border-left:3px solid #e5e7eb; padding-left:1rem;",
      "No articles found for this ticker in the selected period."
    )
  } else {
    df_valid |> arrange(desc(publicado)) |> pmap(make_news_card) |> tagList()
  }

  tagList(
    tags$h2(
      tags$span(nome_display),
      tags$code(style = "margin-left:.5rem; font-size:.75em; color:#6b7280;", ticker_key)
    ),
    tags$p(tags$em(paste0(n_articles, " article(s) found in the last ", DAYS_BACK, " days"))),
    cards
  )
}

# Garante que TODOS os tickers aparecem, mesmo sem noticias
sections <- ticker_map |>
  pmap(function(ticker, nome, ...) {
    df_ticker <- news_df |> filter(ticker == !!ticker)
    if (nrow(df_ticker) == 0) {
      df_ticker <- empty_news() |>
        add_row(ticker = ticker, nome = nome, fonte = NA_character_,
                titulo = NA_character_, link = NA_character_,
                veiculo = NA_character_, publicado = as.POSIXct(NA))
    }
    render_ticker_section(ticker, df_ticker)
  })

tagList(sections)
```
